{{Top|leg}}
The '''Card Hall''' was located within the [[Royal Casino/Legends|Royal Casino]] on [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]], [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]]. Card tables for games of chance like [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] and [[Liar's Cut/Legends|Liar's Cut]] were located within the Card Hall.
